evals.expected_output: A new Astro project with pure CSS (no Tailwind), BRIEF.md, tokens on :root, preloader (first visit only), hero, stacked work cards or pinned scene, footer; GSAP + Lenis wired with cleanup and reduced-motion handling; builds successfully.
